rows.author: I027
rows.title_full: AN ACT ELEVATING THE STATUS OF THE CHILDREN BORN OUT OF WEDLOCK, AMENDING FOR THIS PURPOSE ARTICLE 177 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER 209, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract:
Declares that \"Children conceived and born outside of wedlock may be legitimized by a subsequent valid marriage of their parents\" which amends Art. 177 of the Family Code.

States that no court declaration is necessary to effect legitimation, but only an Affidavit of Legitimation may be filed with the Civil Registrar where the records of birth of the child is registered.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING PROTECTION TO CONSUMERS BY EXPANDING THE DEFINITION OF BASIC NECESSITIES AND PRIME COMMODITIES, AMENDING, FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7581, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE PRICE ACT, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to include “new” goods that by virtue of their mass and necessary usage qualify as “Basic Necessities: such as POTABLE WATER IN CONTAINERS, NOODLES, KEROSENE, AND LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS, and such other TYPES AND BRANDS OF GOODS which may be included BY MOTU PROPIO ACTION OF THE CONCERNED AGENCY OF THE PRICE COORDINATING COUNCIL; and any type or brand previously excluded in the definition may be reinstated in times of disaster, calamities, and other emergency crisis.
Seeks to exclude fresh fruits and noodles from the definition of “Prime Commodities” and to include such other TYPES AND BRANDS OF GOODS which may be included BY MOTU PROPIO ACTION OF THE CONCERNED AGENCY OF THE PRICE COORDINATING COUNCIL, and any type or brand previously excluded in the definition may be reinstated in times of disaster, calamities, and other emergency crisis.
